title: Pycaso CMO — Step 3: Physical model comparison & BIC selection

settings.title: CMO microscope
settings.description: Common Main Objective stereo microscope used in the Pycaso open dataset. The StereoComplex case study treats the left and right channels as two effective off-axis CMO sub-apertures. Raw image folders are external and expected under examples/pycaso_data after cloning Pycaso.

data_sets.title: Model comparison
data_sets.description: Comparison of Zernike, telecentric and perspective CMO model families.

data_sets.title: Conditioning diag.
data_sets.description: Design matrix conditioning, modal delta-d and sensitivity diagnostics.

data_sets.title: Moment residual
data_sets.description: Pluecker moment residual decomposition and O1/O2 origin-field tests.

data_sets.title: Pre-warp test
data_sets.description: Negative test showing that affine/quadratic pre-warp degrades pixel RMS and is not the missing degree of freedom.

data_sets.title: BIC selection
data_sets.description: Ray-space BIC and operational BIC with 1.5 px guard for physical model selection on the Pycaso CMO rayfield.
